description: This file defines the SessionRepository class which manages in-memory authentication session state using Kotlin Flow. It provides methods for updating and observing the current authentication state, supporting UI updates and coordination with persistence mechanisms.

classes.name: SessionRepository
classes.description: Manages in-memory authentication session state, providing observable flow for UI components and methods to update session status.

methods.name: stateFlow
methods.description: Returns a read-only StateFlow representing the current authentication state for UI observation.

methods.name: setLoggedOut
methods.description: Sets the current authentication state to LoggedOut.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Sets the current state to Locked with provided session tokens and reason.

methods.name: setUnlocked
methods.description: Sets the current state to Unlocked with provided session tokens.

methods.name: currentTokensOrNull
methods.description: Returns the current session tokens if authenticated, otherwise null.
